AI-assisted software development is the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to augment software development . It uses large language models (LLMs), AI agents and other AI technologies to assist software developers . It helps in a range of tasks of the software development life cycle , from code generation to debugging , editing, testing , UI design, understanding the code, [ 1 ] and documentation . [ 2 ] Agentic coding denotes the use of more autonomous AI agents for software development. [ 3 ]
